title: Google Ads for Mobile Game: High budget in short burst vs. Low budget spread out?
author: Ok_Low_1999
selftext:
Hi everyone,

​I am running a Google Ads campaign for my mobile game and wondering which budget strategy yields better results:

​**High daily budget for a few days** (to create a sudden download spike).

​**Lower daily budget spread over a few weeks.**

​I have heard that a sudden spike in downloads can boost store rankings and trigger organic growth. However, I also know Google’s algorithm needs time to optimize CPI.

​What is your experience? Which strategy works better for driving overall growth and organic installs for a mobile game?

​Thanks!
